name: Horseradish
siboNotes: Fresh horseradish root is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Check prepared horseradish labels for added garlic or onion powder.
preparationTips: Grate fresh horseradish root just before serving for maximum potency
Store prepared horseradish in refrigerator and use within 3-4 weeks
Mix with vinegar or lemon juice to preserve color and flavor
Start with small amounts as horseradish is very potent
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C and antioxidants
